title: Advancing ESG Intelligence: An Expert-level Agent and Comprehensive Benchmark for Sustainable Finance
abstract: arXiv:2601.08676v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Environmental, social, and governance (ESG) criteria are essential for evaluating corporate sustainability and ethical performance. However, professional ESG analysis is hindered by data fragmentation across unstructured sources, and existing large language models (LLMs) often struggle with the complex, multi-step workflows required for rigorous auditing. To address these limitations, we introduce ESGAgent, a hierarchical multi-agent system empowered by a specialized toolset, including retrieval augmentation, web search and domain-specific functions, to generate in-depth ESG analysis. Complementing this agentic system, we present a comprehensive three-level benchmark derived from 310 corporate sustainability reports, designed to evaluate capabilities ranging from atomic common-sense questions to the generation of integrated, in-depth analysis. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that ESGAgent outperforms state-of-the-art closed-source

translated_title: 推进ESG智能：面向可持续金融的专家级智能体与综合基准
translated_abstract: 环境、社会和治理（ESG）标准对于评估企业可持续性和道德表现至关重要。然而，专业的ESG分析受到数据分散于各类非结构化来源的阻碍，且现有的大型语言模型（LLM）在处理严格审计所需的复杂多步骤工作流时往往力不从心。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了ESGAgent，这是一个分层多智能体系统，配备了专门的工具集，包括检索增强、网络搜索和领域特定功能，以生成深入的ESG分析。作为该智能体系统的补充，我们提出了一个基于310份企业可持续发展报告构建的全面三级基准，旨在评估从原子级常识问题到生成综合性深入分析的各项能力。实证评估表明，ESGAgent的表现优于最先进的闭源模型。
tldr: 该论文提出了ESGAgent——一个配备检索增强、网络搜索等专用工具集的分层多智能体系统，用于生成深入的ESG分析，并构建了基于310份企业可持续发展报告的三级综合基准，其性能超越了最先进的闭源模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ESGAgent, a hierarchical multi-agent system with a specialized toolset for generating in-depth ESG analysis, along with a comprehensive three-level benchmark built from 310 corporate sustainability reports, outperforming state-of-the-art closed-source models.
